quote: The art is childish and ugly it's missing any real choices you can't pick any dark, edgey or, funny dialog.  The writing is bad and I mean bad nothing feels organic. The puzzles if you can even call them that are so brain dead a 3 year old could solve it. If your an og dragon age fan this game is not for you. Feels like a different IP.
